ai_summary: A scroll-animated hero section component featuring two coordinated sections that transform on scroll using Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform hooks. The component implements scale (1 to 0.8/0.8 to 1) and rotation (0 to -5/5 to 0 degrees) animations tied to scroll progress. Features gradient backgrounds transitioning from light to dark, grid pattern overlays with radial masks, and clean typography. Designed for creating immersive landing page experiences with modern scroll-driven interactions.
